summary: Addex Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K furnishing a November 11, 2026 press release disclosing that its spin-out Neurosterix closed a $105 million Series B financing from a syndicate of life science investors. Addex did not participate and now holds 8.5% of Neurosterix issued capital, valued at $18.6 million. Proceeds mainly fund Phase 2 development of NTX-253, a muscarinic M4 PAM for schizophrenia, plus the broader pipeline. No board recommendation, advisor, price per share, or closing date is stated; the event is the spin-out's external capitalization and Addex's dilution to a minority stake. Watch for further Addex stake sales or distributions.
